main_text.p: & pronepote habeas, mortuis utriusque, pronepos instutus succedens in sui heredis locum, non rumpat. Et be ne uerba sic habet, SI QVIS EX SVIS HEREDIBVS SVVS HERES ESSE DESIERIT, ad omnes casus pertinentia, quos supplendos in Galli Aquilij sententia dixi-mus. Nec solū si nepos uiuo patre decedat, {*}nec succedēs {*}pronepos auo mortuorum {*}pat: sed & si superuixit patri, ac decedat, dūmodo heres instatutus sit, aut exheredatus.
Succedentes in locum liberorum.) Qui e familia demígrant, suíq; esse desinunt. Huc autem Caij pertinet explicatio

page.notes: The outer-margin quotation marks («) repeated at each line are printer's marks and are not transcribed. The asterisks in the text are reference marks; the margin notes "*ne", "patri" and "nepos." are read beside their lines. The "e" in "Qui é fa" carries an acute accent as printed. The final commentary sentence runs on to the next page. Catchword "postu-" and signature "p 4" are read at the foot; the letter "L" before "postu-" is faint and not transcribed. The long s in "suíq;" is read from a faint letter and should be checked.
